body.name: Equality-aware effect inversion
body.construction: Compute \(\mathcal B(a)\), evaluate \(\mathsf{ChamberMax}\) once on every open component of \(\mathbb R\setminus\mathcal B(a)\) and once at every point of \(\mathcal B(a)\), and return exactly those cells on which \(P_\delta(a)>\alpha\).
